Where you'll live

Villa Kassar, El Baeirat

A private villa on Luxor's West Bank, where the green fields meet the desert, about 1 km from the temple of Medinet Habu. The whole house is ours for the week: no other guests, no hotel lobby. Classes happen here every morning, and dinner is usually on the roof.

The house

6 bedroomswith air conditioning
4½ bathshot water
Poolplus a garden plunge pool
Rooftopdinners, ping-pong, mountain view

Rated 4.92 out of 5 by more than 240 past guests. Wifi throughout. This is rural Upper Egypt, so short power cuts can happen; a power bank solves it.

Getting around from here: the Valley of the Kings is about 20 minutes away by minibus, the Colossi about 10. The East Bank (Karnak, the town, the souq) is about 40 minutes, because the road crosses the Nile at Luxor Bridge, south of town.

Who's in the house

  • 7 students, that's you
  • Your Arabic teacher, who lives at the villa with the group all week
  • Mohamed, founder of Arabanion, running the week
  • Merve (@meerrmade), travelling with the group
  • A local coordinator on call for transport, bookings and anything that comes up

Rooms are shared. We are 10 people in 6 bedrooms, so most rooms have two people. We match roommates with you before the trip; tell us if you're coming with a friend or have a preference.

Price and dates

How booking works

One price, nothing hidden on the ground. You pay a deposit to hold your place, the rest a month before we go.

The price

€1,200
€100 pre-trip intensive course€1,100 the retreat

Includes the villa, every meal, daily Arabic classes, the Egyptologist, every site ticket, the balloon, the felucca, a private minibus all week and Luxor airport transfers.

Not included: international flights, your visa, travel insurance, shopping and tips.

Key dates

  • When you book€300 deposit. Holds your bed. Your pre-trip course opens.
  • Before you flyIntensive course. Recorded lessons plus live sessions on the Egyptian dialect.
  • 14 Nov 2026€900 balance due.
  • Mon 14 DecLand in Luxor. We collect you whenever you arrive.
  • Mon 21 DecFly home. Transfer timed to your flight.

If plans change

What you get back if you cancel:

Up to 14 NovEverything back except the €100 course
15–29 Nov€550 back
From 30 NovNo refund, but you can give your place to someone else

If we ever cancel the retreat, you get 100% back. The €100 course is non-refundable once you have access to it.

Before you fly

Packing for Luxor in December

Days are warm and sunny, around 22–24°C. Nights and early mornings are cold, close to 6–8°C, and the balloon goes up before sunrise. Pack layers. Your ticks are saved in this browser only.
